scope: Read-only comparison of the actual historical B2 comparator and frozen V27; no training, evaluation or protocol change

decision.reason: No material data, source, training-budget or evaluation mismatch was found. Method-specific hyperparameters and extra operations do not invalidate end-to-end performance comparison. There is no evidence-based reason to remove B2 because recent candidates fail the gate.
decision.V27: Continue the original frozen protocol and F5/B2 dual gates
decision.scientific_boundary: This is an operational development criterion, not a journal requirement or independent confirmation. Use V13/V21 as module controls. A future protocol with material data/evaluation changes must re-establish comparator compatibility before reusing B2.

identities.B2: B2_PARENT_PAS_KL_C06, confirmation P1, seeds 163 and 164, orders 1 and 2
identities.B2_import: The four 163/164 order-specific final rows from confirmation PUBLIC_RESULTS.json, through module-pilots RESULTS.json historical_refs. Seed 162 and early single-seed replication tables are not used in this gate.

matched.data: Same canonical fundus manifest and primary_20pct_split, split seed 0; optimization seeds 163/164 do not create new patient splits
matched.source: Both protocols use the same retained SOURCE_S163 and SOURCE_S164 receipts/checkpoints, each 8000 REFUGE CE updates and zero U batches; no fresh source training
matched.training_budget: 3200 RIM and 2100 Drishti updates per trajectory; 4 trajectories, 8 target stages, 21200 target updates each
matched.input: RGB 384x384, batch 2, FP32, no autocast, TF32 off; classes background=0/rim=1/cup=2/ignore=255
matched.sampler: Identical NativeCurrentDomain and stateless generator/geometry/LCTX/UL recipes, keyed by seed/order/stage/step/stream without arm; current L image+GT and current U image+geometry only; no old-image replay or U GT
matched.backbone: NATIVE_LR_SRC_A_3DOMAIN_V1, same native JASCL build, linear deterministic readout, LR_SRC_A rank-8 adapters and hard input projection
matched.optimizer: Adam, default betas .9/.999 and eps 1e-8; base lr .001, A/B initial lr .0005, weight decay 4e-5, polynomial power .9; U warmup fraction .2 and ramp fraction .2
matched.evaluation: Same native_runner.evaluate, evaluation_data, CurrentData and segmentation_metrics implementation; sealed end-of-stage student on seen-domain val; argmax deterministic readout, case-mean rim/cup Dice then equal class/domain/order/seed aggregation; no test or future-domain evaluation
matched.metrics: Final=mean of three final domain macro Dice; Old=mean of first two final domains; Incoming=final third domain; Forget=mean source and first-target earlier-to-final decline, not maximum-history forgetting

B2.description: Parent A/B LCTX supervised CE+Dice and EMA PAS KL; no R/Q/SWD, frozen-entry reference gradient guard or hierarchy term

V27.description: V13 joint KL A/B/R, clean SWD R-only, class-balanced frozen-entry reference and raw-gradient guard; linear rank-4 R/Q sidecar; current-L hierarchy coarse+sibling contrast weight .1, temperature .1; child-parent attraction removed

method_differences.interpretation: Different objectives, thresholds, gradient routes, representation capacity and compute are intentional method differences. B2 is a strong end-to-end comparator, not an isolated control for the V27 hierarchy module. Full-ramp U coefficients differ; no equal-strength causal claim is made.

compute.interpretation: Matched update budget is not matched compute. Do not claim compute-normalized superiority or infer runtime efficiency from shared-GPU wall time.

reviewed_changed_shared_files.five_frameworks_v1/native_parent.py: git cwd invocation instead of -C; EMA decay keyword retains exact .99/.01 default; adapters, input projection, supervised loss and readout methods unchanged
reviewed_changed_shared_files.five_frameworks_v1/train_stage.py: Explicit extension hooks, optimizer sidecar parameter API, detach routing and sidecar EMA extension; B2 base hooks are no-ops, B2 has no sidecar and retains parent U gradients; new method hooks remain intentional differences
reviewed_changed_shared_files.five_frameworks_v1/model.py: Sidecar parameter/EMA extension and explicit detach_u_parent; Deployment unchanged; B2 no-sidecar path remains parent-only

targeted_verification.V27_qualification: Existing disabled archived-V13 full-state/loss/update parity and native data/teacher/resume/deployment checks reused; no qualification repeated

selection_and_limits.B2_selection: C06 selected on development seed 161 from eight B2 candidates, then fixed for the new 163/164 confirmation runs; not selected from their final outcomes
selection_and_limits.current_method_selection: Many subsequent method rounds reuse the same development patients and 163/164 matrix; tuning budgets are unequal and independent superiority is not established
selection_and_limits.readout_timing: Historical B2 evaluates each sealed stage before its next stage; V27 postpones uniform evaluation until all targets seal. Evaluation implementation matches and neither protocol uses validation feedback for optimization/checkpoint selection. Timing is documented rather than claimed identical.
selection_and_limits.not_checked_or_run: No new model forward, optimizer, evaluation, patient-level metric read, artifact rehash or B2 rerun. Existing frozen metadata and source receipts establish provenance; this audit does not establish fresh byte-level equality of all private HDF5 or checkpoint payloads.
selection_and_limits.gate_limit: The .5pp average gain and seed/order/class safeguards are frozen operational tolerances, not statistical significance or a clinically validated margin. Two optimization seeds and repeatedly reused validation patients do not establish generalization.

privacy: Only protocol identifiers, anonymous counts, options and aggregate checks are published; private configurations, patient rows, data, weights and raw logs remain on NAS
